items.title: Remove the caravan and its wooden extension from the plot
items.quote: Sie haben den auf dem Grundstück Fl.-Nr. 412/3 abgestellten Wohnwagen samt dem angebauten Holzvorbau bis spätestens 26.02.2027 zu entfernen.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for this obligation: 26.02.2027. No counting rule is needed; this is the last day the removal must be completed.

items.title: Deadline to file Klage with the Bavarian Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by a Bavarian authority. Under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Sun 22.11.2026 (this day does not shift even though it is a Sunday, per the deemed-delivery rule for authority letters). The one-month Klage period (§ 74 VwGO) then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: it starts the next day (23.11.2026) and ends one month later on the date numerically corresponding to the delivery day, i.e. Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in Bayern, so it is not shifted. Note: if this proceeding had already begun before 1 January 2025 under Bavaria's own transitional rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG), a 3-day deemed-delivery rule could apply instead, moving delivery to Sat 21.11.2026 and the deadline to Mon 21.12.2026 — but the Anhörungsverfahren described in the letter appears to be a 2026 matter, so the standard 4-day rule is used here.

warnings: If the removal deadline of 26.02.2027 is not met, the letter threatens a Zwangsgeld (coercive penalty payment) of €2,000 — this is a conditional threat tied to Item 1's deadline, not a separate payment due now.

Widerspruch is explicitly excluded for this matter ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen'); only Klage (court action) is available, and only within the one-month period — get advice (e.g. a lawyer or the Verwaltungsgericht's Rechtsantragstelle) well before 22.12.2026 if you intend to challenge the order.

The IBAN printed in the letterhead (DE88 7435 1000 0002 0007 00) is well-formed, but no payment is currently demanded by this letter; do not use it to pay anything unless a separate, verified Zwangsgeld notice asks for payment.
